app.title: mayoiga interactive setup
prompt.name: Mapping name:
prompt.coordinator: Upstream coordinator HTTPS URL (empty for none):
prompt.replace_existing: Allow replacing an existing credential? Type yes to confirm:
error.node_signature_invalid: The node credential is invalid, revoked, or its clock differs by more than two minutes.
error.connection_node_inactive: The source or target node is offline or has not completed discovery.
error.published_service_missing: The target does not currently publish the requested service.
error.return_relay_invalid: The requested return relay is not active in the source segment.
error.connection_capacity_reached: The coordinator connection-request capacity is full; retry later.
error.connection_target_queue_full: The target already has too many pending connection requests.
error.connection_request_missing: The connection request no longer exists or has expired.
error.connection_decision_forbidden: Only the target node may accept or reject this connection request.
error.connection_cancel_forbidden: Only the source node may cancel this connection request.
error.connection_state_terminal: This connection request has already reached a final state.
error.connection_reason_too_long: The connection reason must be at most 512 characters.
error.enrollment_reason_too_long: The enrollment reason must be at most 512 characters.
error.enrollment_missing_or_expired: The enrollment request was not found or has expired; configure the node to request a new code.
error.enrollment_rejected: The coordinator rejected this enrollment request.
error.node_credential_conflict: This node ID already has a different credential; explicit replacement is required.
error.handshake_invalid: The relay handshake is invalid or incomplete.
error.source_unauthorized: The relay could not verify the source node credential.
error.source_route_denied: This subnode is assigned to a different upstream relay.
error.reverse_unexpected: The reverse connection request is no longer pending; retry the pull.
error.mode_unsupported: The relay does not support this handshake mode.
error.target_service_missing: The target node or published service is unavailable.
error.cross_segment_denied: This source is not authorized for cross-segment relay routing.
error.target_unavailable: No authenticated path to the target service is currently available.
error.coordinator_tunnel_unauthorized: The relay admission token is missing, invalid, or not assigned to this subnode.
error.coordinator_tunnel_busy: The relay is busy serving coordinator tunnels; retry shortly.
error.coordinator_tunnel_unavailable: The relay has no valid upstream coordinator configuration.
error.coordinator_unavailable: The relay cannot reach its configured coordinator.
